hotHint: These switches only affect probe verdicts, not business behavior. Both are hot-editable and take effect on the next health check.
loadFailed: Failed to load health probe settings. Check that the backend is reachable and you have config:health:read.
saveFailed: Save failed. Check the values or your permissions.
endpointTitle: Which Endpoint Should Each Probe Use
endpointDesc: The aggregate /actuator/health includes dependency components and suits alerting. Orchestration probes should use liveness / readiness so a dependency blip does not drain the replica.
rowLivenessSemantics: Only livenessState and ping; UP while the process is alive
rowReadinessSemantics: Only readinessState; excludes db/redis by default
rowAlertSemantics: DOWN as soon as any component is DOWN — which is what alerts need
readinessDesc: When enabled, /actuator/health/readiness also checks db and redis; if either is unavailable the replica leaves the ready set. Disabled by default to preserve pre-3.8.6 behavior.
readinessSwitchHint: Drains traffic on dependency failure; rolling updates stall while the dependency is down
jwtRedisDesc: Controls whether the jwtRedis component turns the aggregate health endpoint DOWN when Redis is unreachable. Multi-replica deployments must enable JWT Redis persistence and blacklist, so this switch decides whether a Redis blip drains replicas.
jwtRedisSwitch: Report DOWN when Redis is unreachable
jwtRedisSwitchHint: When off, only component details note the impact; aggregate health no longer returns 503
